Choose a body, a mesh, and a material, and set the boundary conditions by clicking on the sides of the body.
For each side and each direction, choose whether it is free, carries a traction (Neumann), or has a prescribed displacement (Dirichlet).
The solution updates as you move the sliders.
Then look through the tabs.
**Solution** shows the deformed body, colored by the quantity you choose, with the checks of equilibrium.
**Element arrays** shows $\mathrm{IEN}$, $\mathrm{LM}$, $\mathbf{D}$, $\mathbf{B}$, and $\mathbf{k}^e$ for one element, and the eigenvalues of $\mathbf{k}^e$.
**Matrices** shows the $\mathrm{ID}$ array and the pattern of $\mathbf{K}$.
**Check** compares the solution with what is known about each problem.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {CANTILEVER, PLATE, WSHAPE, GEOMETRIES, createSolver, bcToData, bcEditor, planeGraphic,
        deformedCanvas, drawDeformed, drawDeformedMesh, drawOutline, drawGlyphs, evaluate, nodalStress,
        fieldValue, vonMises, locate, cantileverExact, heywood, kEntries, sideNodes}
  from "./elast2d.js"
import {drawSpy} from "./fem2d.js"
import {texMatrix, num} from "./fem1d.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
fmt = (v, d = 2) => (v < -0.5 * 10 ** -d ? "−" : "") + Math.abs(v).toFixed(d)
solver = createSolver()
```

**The body and the mesh**

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof geom = Inputs.radio(new Map([
  ["a plate with a hole", "plate"],
  ["a quarter of the plate, by symmetry", "quarter"],
  [`the cross-section of a ${WSHAPE.name}`, "wshape"],
  ["the cantilever (exact solution known)", "cantilever"]]), {value: "plate", label: "Body"})
viewof pdeg = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Q4: bilinear", 1], ["Q9: biquadratic", 2]]), {value: 2, label: "Elements"})
viewof lev = Inputs.range([1, 4], {value: 2, step: 1, label: "Mesh: 1 coarse … 4 fine"})
```

**Plane stress or plane strain**

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof plane = Inputs.radio(new Map([["plane stress: a thin plate", "stress"], ["plane strain: a long body", "strain"]]),
  {value: GEOMETRIES[geom].plane, label: "Model"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
planeGraphic(geom, plane, {width: Math.min(width, 380)})
```

**The material**

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
MATERIALS = new Map([["steel", [200, 0.3]], ["aluminum", [70, 0.33]], ["concrete", [30, 0.2]]])
viewof mat = Inputs.select(MATERIALS, {label: "Start from"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof EG = Inputs.range([1, 300], {value: mat[0], step: 1, label: "E (GPa)"})
viewof nu = Inputs.range([0, 0.45], {value: mat[1], step: 0.01, label: "ν"})
```

**The boundary conditions**

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof bc = geom === "cantilever"
  ? Inputs.form({
      end: Inputs.radio(new Map([["the exact displacements", "exact"], ["clamped: u₁ = u₂ = 0", "clamp"]]),
                        {value: "exact", label: "Left end"}),
      P: Inputs.range([-20, 20], {value: 8, step: 0.5, label: "End load P (kN, downward)"})})
  : bcEditor(geom)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
G = GEOMETRIES[geom]
mesh = G.make(pdeg, lev)
E = 1000 * EG
tPlate = plane === "stress" ? G.t : 1
cantEx = {
  // the exact solution with the same end tractions in either model (per mm of length in plane strain)
  if (geom !== "cantilever") return null;
  const P = 1000 * bc.P * (plane === "stress" ? 1 : 1 / CANTILEVER.t);
  return (x, y) => cantileverExact(x, y, E, nu, plane, {P});
}
bcState = geom === "cantilever"
  ? {left: {x: ["disp", 0], y: ["disp", 0]}, right: {x: ["free", 0], y: ["traction", -bc.P]}}
  : bc
bcData = geom === "cantilever"
  ? {dirichlet: bc.end === "exact" ? {left: {0: (x, y) => cantEx(x, y).u1, 1: (x, y) => cantEx(x, y).u2}} : {left: {0: 0, 1: 0}},
     traction: {right: (x, y) => [0, cantEx(x, y).s12]}}
  : bcToData(bc, geom)
sol = solver(mesh, {E, nu, plane, t: G.t, dirichlet: bcData.dirichlet, traction: bcData.traction})
nodal = sol.ok ? nodalStress(sol) : null
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof eSel = Inputs.range([1, mesh.nel], {value: Math.min(1, mesh.nel), step: 1, label: "Highlight element e"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const why = () => {
    if (sol.reason === "an element is folded") return "an element is folded (J ≤ 0).";
    if (sol.reason === "every displacement component is prescribed") return "every displacement is prescribed, so there is nothing to solve for.";
    const fx = sol.fixed[0].some(v => v), fy = sol.fixed[1].some(v => v);
    const what = !fx && !fy ? "nothing holds the body"
      : !fx ? "nothing stops it from sliding along x₁"
      : !fy ? "nothing stops it from sliding along x₂"
      : "the supports cannot stop it from rotating";
    return `K is singular: ${what}. Prescribe more displacement components, so that no rigid-body motion is left.`;
  };
  const nPres = sol.fixed[0].filter(v => v).length + sol.fixed[1].filter(v => v).length;
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.95rem; margin:0.3rem 0 0.6rem 0; padding:0.5rem 0.8rem; background:#fff; border-left:4px solid #1e3a5f;">
    <b>${mesh.nel}</b> ${pdeg === 1 ? "Q4" : "Q9"} elements, <b>${mesh.nnp}</b> nodes, <b>${2 * mesh.nnp}</b> displacement components,
    of which <b>${nPres}</b> are prescribed &rarr; <b>${sol.neq}</b> equations.
    ${plane === "stress" ? `Plane stress, thickness t = ${G.t} mm.` : "Plane strain: forces per mm of length along x₃."}
    ${sol.rebuilt ? "K was assembled and factored again." : "K was reused: only the loads or prescribed values changed, or E, which scales K."}
    (${sol.ms.toFixed(0)} ms)
    ${sol.ok ? "" : html`<br><span style="color:#c0392b"><b>No solution:</b> ${why()}</span>`}
  </div>`;
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Solution

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof field = Inputs.select(new Map([
  ["von Mises stress", "vm"], ["σ₁₁", "s11"], ["σ₂₂", "s22"], ["σ₁₂", "s12"], ["σ₃₃", "s33"],
  ["|u|, the size of the displacement", "|u|"], ["u₁", "u1"], ["u₂", "u2"]]), {value: "vm", label: "Color by"})
viewof magMul = Inputs.range([0, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Exaggerate the displacements (× automatic)"})
viewof show = Inputs.checkbox(["the mesh", "supports and loads", "average the stresses at the nodes"],
  {value: ["the mesh", "supports and loads", "average the stresses at the nodes"], label: "Show"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  if (!sol.ok) return html`<div style="color:#c0392b">Nothing to draw until the problem has a unique solution.</div>`;
  const avg = show.includes("average the stresses at the nodes");
  const xs = mesh.X.map(p => p[0]), ys = mesh.X.map(p => p[1]);
  const span = Math.max(d3.max(xs) - d3.min(xs), d3.max(ys) - d3.min(ys));
  const umax = d3.max(sol.U, u => Math.hypot(u[0], u[1]));
  const auto = umax > 0 ? 0.07 * span / umax : 0, scale = magMul * auto;
  const k = mesh.nel > 500 ? 2 : 3, memo = new Map();
  const val = (e, xi, eta) => {
    const key = `${e},${xi.toFixed(4)},${eta.toFixed(4)}`;
    if (!memo.has(key)) memo.set(key, fieldValue(sol, field, e, xi, eta, avg ? nodal : null));
    return memo.get(key);
  };
  let lo = Infinity, hi = -Infinity;
  for (let e = 1; e <= mesh.nel; e++) for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) {
    const v = val(e, -1 + 2 * (i + 0.5) / k, -1 + 2 * (j + 0.5) / k);
    lo = Math.min(lo, v); hi = Math.max(hi, v);
  }
  const signed = !["vm", "|u|"].includes(field);
  let color, legend;
  const labels = {vm: "von Mises stress (MPa)", s11: "σ₁₁ (MPa)", s22: "σ₂₂ (MPa)", s12: "σ₁₂ (MPa)", s33: "σ₃₃ (MPa)",
                  "|u|": "|u| (mm)", u1: "u₁ (mm)", u2: "u₂ (mm)"};
  if (signed) {
    const m = Math.max(Math.abs(lo), Math.abs(hi), 1e-12);
    color = d3.scaleDiverging([-m, 0, m], t => d3.interpolateRdBu(1 - t));
    legend = Plot.legend({color: {type: "diverging", domain: [-m, m], scheme: "RdBu", reverse: true, label: labels[field]}, width: 320});
  } else {
    color = d3.scaleSequential([0, Math.max(hi, 1e-12)], d3.interpolateYlOrRd);
    legend = Plot.legend({color: {type: "linear", domain: [0, Math.max(hi, 1e-12)], scheme: "YlOrRd", label: labels[field]}, width: 320});
  }
  const cv = deformedCanvas(Math.min(width, 640), mesh, sol, scale);
  drawOutline(cv, G.outline());
  drawDeformed(cv, mesh, sol, val, color, scale, k);
  if (show.includes("the mesh")) drawDeformedMesh(cv, mesh, sol, scale, {highlight: eSel, color: "rgba(26,26,26,0.35)", width: 0.6});
  if (show.includes("supports and loads")) {
    const tMax = Math.max(...Object.values(bcState).flatMap(s => ["x", "y"].map(d => s[d] && s[d][0] === "traction" ? Math.abs(s[d][1]) : 0)), 1e-9);
    drawGlyphs(cv, G.sides(), bcState, {tMax, uMax: Math.abs(G.uRange[1]), size: 0.06 * span, maxArrow: 1.6});
  }
  // readouts
  let iu = 0;
  sol.U.forEach((u, A) => { if (Math.hypot(...u) > Math.hypot(...sol.U[iu])) iu = A; });
  const vmN = nodal.map(([a, b, c]) => vonMises(a, b, c, plane === "strain" ? nu * (a + b) : 0));
  let iv = 0;
  vmN.forEach((v, A) => { if (v > vmN[iv]) iv = A; });
  const sumR = [0, 1].map(i => d3.sum(sol.R, r => r[i])), sumF = [0, 1].map(i => d3.sum(sol.Ffull[i]));
  // the reaction carried by each supported side; a node on two supported sides counts once, for the first
  const claimed = new Set(), bySide = [];
  for (const sd of G.sides()) {
    if (!bcData.dirichlet[sd.name]) continue;
    let r1 = 0, r2 = 0;
    for (const A of sideNodes(mesh, sd.name)) {
      if (claimed.has(A)) continue;
      claimed.add(A); r1 += sol.R[A - 1][0]; r2 += sol.R[A - 1][1];
    }
    bySide.push(`&nbsp; ${sd.label}: (${fmt(r1, 1)}, ${fmt(r2, 1)})`);
  }
  const unitF = plane === "stress" ? "N" : "N/mm";
  let extra = "";
  if (geom === "plate" || geom === "quarter") {
    const loc = locate(mesh, 0, PLATE.a);
    if (loc) {
      const s11 = evaluate(sol, ...loc).sig[0];
      const st = bcState.right && bcState.right.x && bcState.right.x[0] === "traction" ? bcState.right.x[1] : null;
      extra = `<b>At the top of the hole:</b> σ₁₁ = ${fmt(s11, 1)} MPa` + (st ? `, ${fmt(s11 / st, 2)} times the applied ${fmt(st, 0)} MPa. Heywood's estimate for this plate: ${fmt(heywood(2 * PLATE.a, PLATE.W, st).peak, 1)} MPa.` : ".");
    }
  } else if (geom === "wshape") {
    let it = 0;
    mesh.X.forEach(([x, y], A) => { if (Math.hypot(x + WSHAPE.bf / 2, y - WSHAPE.d) < Math.hypot(mesh.X[it][0] + WSHAPE.bf / 2, mesh.X[it][1] - WSHAPE.d)) it = A; });
    extra = `<b>Left tip of the top flange:</b> u = (${fmt(sol.U[it][0], 4)}, ${fmt(sol.U[it][1], 4)}) mm.`;
  } else {
    const loc = locate(mesh, CANTILEVER.L, 0), uh = evaluate(sol, ...loc).u[1], ue = cantEx(CANTILEVER.L, 0).u2;
    extra = `<b>Tip deflection</b> at mid-depth: u₂ = ${fmt(uh, 4)} mm; exact ${fmt(ue, 4)} mm (${(100 * uh / ue).toFixed(1)}%)` +
            (bc.end === "clamp" ? ". The exact value assumes the warped end of the exact solution, not a clamp." : ".");
  }
  return html`<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:1.2rem; align-items:flex-start">
    <div>${legend}${cv.canvas}
      <div style="font-size:0.85rem; color:#555; max-width:640px">Displacements magnified ${scale.toFixed(0)} times. The dashed outline is the undeformed body; the orange outline is element ${eSel}.
      Navy hatching marks a side held in both directions; navy triangles mark a side held in one direction only, free to slide in the other (filled when the prescribed value is zero).
      Navy arrows are prescribed nonzero displacements; red arrows are applied tractions.</div></div>
    <div style="flex:1; min-width:16rem; font-size:0.93rem; line-height:1.6">
      <b>Largest displacement:</b> ${fmt(Math.hypot(...sol.U[iu]), 4)} mm at node ${iu + 1}, (${mesh.X[iu].map(v => v.toFixed(1)).join(", ")}) mm<br>
      <b>Largest von Mises stress</b> (nodal average): ${fmt(vmN[iv], 1)} MPa at node ${iv + 1}, (${mesh.X[iv].map(v => v.toFixed(1)).join(", ")}) mm<br><br>
      ${html([extra])}<br><br>
      <b>Equilibrium</b>, summed over the whole body:<br>
      &nbsp; applied loads: (${fmt(sumF[0], 1)}, ${fmt(sumF[1], 1)}) ${unitF}<br>
      &nbsp; support reactions: (${fmt(sumR[0], 1)}, ${fmt(sumR[1], 1)}) ${unitF}<br>
      <span style="color:#555">The applied loads include any traction on a prescribed component, which the support absorbs directly.
      The two rows cancel on every mesh: the basis functions add up to 1, so a rigid translation is a finite element displacement field, and it strains nothing.</span><br><br>
      <b>Reactions by supported side</b> (${unitF}):<br>
      ${html([bySide.join("<br>")])}<br>
      <span style="color:#555">A node on two supported sides is counted once, for the side listed first.
      A support whose reaction is near zero does almost nothing, because the body would hardly have moved there anyway.
      Supports added to the clamped bottom flange of the W-shape are an example.</span>
    </div></div>`;
}
```

### Element arrays

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof gpSel = Inputs.range([1, (pdeg + 1) ** 2], {value: 1, step: 1, label: "Gauss point l"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const e = Math.min(eSel, mesh.nel), ien = mesh.IEN[e - 1], lm = sol.LM[e - 1], nen = mesh.nen;
  const ke = sol.ke(e), gp = sol.gp(e)[Math.min(gpSel, (pdeg + 1) ** 2) - 1];
  const Dg = sol.D.map(r => r.map(v => v / 1000));
  const cell = (v, red) => `<td style="padding:1px 6px; text-align:center; ${red ? "color:#c0392b; font-weight:700" : ""}">${v}</td>`;
  const rowA = ien.map((A, a) => cell(a + 1)).join(""), rowIEN = ien.map(A => cell(A)).join("");
  const rowP = lm.map((_, p) => cell(p + 1)).join(""), rowIA = lm.map((_, p) => cell(`${(p % 2) + 1},${(p >> 1) + 1}`)).join("");
  const rowLM = lm.map(P => cell(P === 0 ? "0" : P, P === 0)).join("");
  const table = `<table style="font-size:0.85rem; white-space:nowrap; margin:0.3rem 0 0.6rem 0">
    <tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-right:8px; font-weight:normal">local node a</th>${rowA}</tr>
    <tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-right:8px; font-weight:normal">IEN(a, ${e})</th>${rowIEN}</tr></table>
    <div style="overflow-x:auto"><table style="font-size:0.85rem; white-space:nowrap; margin:0 0 0.6rem 0">
    <tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-right:8px; font-weight:normal">p = 2(a − 1) + i</th>${rowP}</tr>
    <tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-right:8px; font-weight:normal; color:#777">(i, a)</th>${rowIA}</tr>
    <tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-right:8px; font-weight:normal">LM(p, ${e})</th>${rowLM}</tr></table></div>`;
  // eigenvalues of k^e by Jacobi rotations
  const n = ke.length, A = ke.map(r => r.slice());
  for (let sweep = 0; sweep < 60; sweep++) {
    let off = 0;
    for (let p = 0; p < n; p++) for (let q = p + 1; q < n; q++) off += A[p][q] ** 2;
    if (off < 1e-22 * d3.sum(A.map((r, i) => r[i] ** 2))) break;
    for (let p = 0; p < n; p++) for (let q = p + 1; q < n; q++) {
      if (Math.abs(A[p][q]) < 1e-300) continue;
      const th = 0.5 * Math.atan2(2 * A[p][q], A[q][q] - A[p][p]), c = Math.cos(th), s = Math.sin(th);
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const akp = A[k][p], akq = A[k][q]; A[k][p] = c * akp - s * akq; A[k][q] = s * akp + c * akq; }
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const apk = A[p][k], aqk = A[q][k]; A[p][k] = c * apk - s * aqk; A[q][k] = s * apk + c * aqk; }
    }
  }
  const eig = A.map((r, i) => r[i]).sort((a, b) => a - b), emax = eig[eig.length - 1];
  const nZero = eig.filter(v => Math.abs(v) < 1e-9 * emax).length;
  const sc = x => html`<div style="overflow-x:auto; max-width:100%; font-size:${pdeg === 2 ? 0.8 : 1}em">${x}</div>`;
  const kScale = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(emax));
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.93rem; line-height:1.55">
    <b>Element ${e}</b>: ${nen} nodes, ${2 * nen} local equations. A red 0 in LM is a prescribed component.
    ${html([table])}
    ${sc(tex.block`\mathbf{D} = ${texMatrix(Dg, {sig: 4})}\ \text{GPa}\qquad (\text{plane ${plane}},\ E = ${EG}\ \text{GPa},\ \nu = ${nu})`)}
    At Gauss point ${gpSel}, (ξ, η) = (${fmt(gp.xi, 4)}, ${fmt(gp.eta, 4)}), x = (${gp.x.map(v => v.toFixed(2)).join(", ")}) mm, j = ${fmt(gp.J, 3)} mm², W = ${fmt(gp.w, 4)}:
    ${sc(tex.block`\mathbf{B} = ${texMatrix(gp.B, {sig: 3, maxn: 18, show: 6})}\ \text{mm}^{-1}`)}
    ${sc(tex.block`\mathbf{k}^e = ${texMatrix(ke, {sig: 3, maxn: 10, show: 4, scale: kScale})} \times 10^{${Math.round(Math.log10(kScale))}}\ \text{N/mm}`)}
    <b>Eigenvalues of k<sup>e</sup></b> (N/mm): ${eig.map(v => Math.abs(v) < 1e-9 * emax ? "<b>0</b>" : v.toExponential(2)).join(", ")}.<br>
    <span style="color:#555">${nZero === 3 ? "Three are zero: the two translations and the rotation, which strain nothing." : `${nZero} are zero.`}
    The rest are positive: k<sup>e</sup> is positive semidefinite, and the supports of the body make the assembled K positive definite.</span>
  </div>`;
}
```

### Matrices

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const nShow = Math.min(mesh.nnp, 40), lm = sol.LM[Math.min(eSel, mesh.nel) - 1], ien = mesh.IEN[Math.min(eSel, mesh.nel) - 1];
  const first = Math.max(1, Math.min(d3.min(ien) - 4, mesh.nnp - nShow + 1));
  const cell = (v, on, red) => `<td style="padding:1px 6px; text-align:center; ${on ? "background:#fde9d2;" : ""} ${red ? "color:#c0392b; font-weight:700" : ""}">${v}</td>`;
  const nodes = d3.range(first, first + nShow);
  const idTable = `<div style="overflow-x:auto"><table style="font-size:0.84rem; white-space:nowrap">
    <tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-right:8px">A</th>${first > 1 ? "<td>…</td>" : ""}${nodes.map(A => cell(A, ien.includes(A))).join("")}${first + nShow - 1 < mesh.nnp ? "<td>…</td>" : ""}</tr>
    <tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-right:8px; font-weight:normal">ID(1, A)</th>${first > 1 ? "<td></td>" : ""}${nodes.map(A => cell(sol.ID[0][A - 1], ien.includes(A), sol.ID[0][A - 1] === 0)).join("")}</tr>
    <tr><th style="text-align:left; padding-right:8px; font-weight:normal">ID(2, A)</th>${first > 1 ? "<td></td>" : ""}${nodes.map(A => cell(sol.ID[1][A - 1], ien.includes(A), sol.ID[1][A - 1] === 0)).join("")}</tr>
  </table></div>`;
  let spy;
  if (sol.neq <= 3000 && sol.neq > 0) {
    const ent = kEntries(sol), hi = [];
    for (const P of lm) if (P) for (const Q of lm) if (Q) hi.push([P - 1, Q - 1]);
    spy = drawSpy(Math.min(width, 420), sol.neq, ent, {highlight: hi, title: `K: ${sol.neq} × ${sol.neq}, ${ent.length} nonzeros (${(100 * ent.length / sol.neq ** 2).toFixed(2)}%)`});
  } else spy = html`<div style="color:#555">K has ${sol.neq} equations, too many to draw here: choose a coarser mesh or Q4 elements.</div>`;
  const nnzRow = sol.neq ? (kEntries(sol).length / sol.neq).toFixed(1) : 0;
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.93rem; line-height:1.55">
    <b>The ID array</b>${mesh.nnp > nShow ? ` (nodes ${first} to ${first + nShow - 1} of ${mesh.nnp})` : ""}: a red 0 is a prescribed component. The nodes of element ${eSel} are shaded.
    ${html([idTable])}
    <div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:1.2rem; align-items:flex-start; margin-top:0.6rem">
      <div>${spy}</div>
      <div style="flex:1; min-width:15rem">
        Each dark square is a nonzero entry of K; the red ones receive a contribution from element ${eSel}.
        The nonzeros come in 2 × 2 blocks, one for each pair of nodes that share an element, and they hug the diagonal because the nodes are numbered by reverse Cuthill–McKee.<br><br>
        On average a row has ${nnzRow} nonzeros. The factorization stores ${sol.profile ?? "—"} numbers, the profile of K below its diagonal: far fewer than the ${sol.neq ** 2} of a full matrix.
      </div></div>
  </div>`;
}
```

### Check

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  if (!sol.ok) return html`<div style="color:#c0392b">Nothing to check until the problem has a unique solution.</div>`;
  const avg = show.includes("average the stresses at the nodes");
  const at = (x, y, kind) => { const loc = locate(mesh, x, y); return loc ? fieldValue(sol, kind, ...loc, avg ? nodal : null) : null; };
  if (geom === "cantilever") {
    const L = CANTILEVER.L, Dd = CANTILEVER.D, dx = 0.01;
    const xs = d3.range(0, 81).map(k => k * L / 80), ys = d3.range(0, 41).map(k => -Dd / 2 + k * Dd / 40);
    const dfl = xs.map(x => ({x, fe: at(x, 0, "u2"), ex: cantEx(x, 0).u2}));
    // x1 = L/2 is an edge between elements: without averaging, show the stress on both sides of it
    const sides = avg ? [["fe", 0]] : [["left", -dx], ["right", dx]];
    const prof = kind => ys.map(y => Object.assign({y, ex: cantEx(L / 2, y)[kind]},
      ...sides.map(([k, o]) => ({[k]: at(L / 2 + o, y, kind)}))));
    const s11 = prof("s11"), s12 = prof("s12");
    const fe = data => sides.map(([k], j) => Plot.line(data, {x: k, y: "y", stroke: j ? "#e67e22" : "#c0392b", strokeWidth: 2}));
    const w = Math.min(width, 330);
    const p1 = Plot.plot({width: w, height: 220, x: {label: "x₁ (mm)"}, y: {label: "u₂ along x₂ = 0 (mm)"}, marks: [
      Plot.line(dfl, {x: "x", y: "ex", stroke: "#1a1a1a", strokeDasharray: "5,4"}), Plot.line(dfl, {x: "x", y: "fe", stroke: "#c0392b", strokeWidth: 2})]});
    const p2 = Plot.plot({width: w, height: 220, x: {label: "σ₁₁ at x₁ = L/2 (MPa)"}, y: {label: "x₂ (mm)"}, marks: [
      Plot.line(s11, {x: "ex", y: "y", stroke: "#1a1a1a", strokeDasharray: "5,4"}), ...fe(s11)]});
    const p3 = Plot.plot({width: w, height: 220, x: {label: "σ₁₂ at x₁ = L/2 (MPa)"}, y: {label: "x₂ (mm)"}, marks: [
      Plot.line(s12, {x: "ex", y: "y", stroke: "#1a1a1a", strokeDasharray: "5,4"}), ...fe(s12)]});
    return html`<div style="font-size:0.93rem; line-height:1.55">The finite element solution (red) against the exact solution (dashed).
      ${bc.end === "clamp" ? "With a clamped end the problem differs from the exact one near the support, so the two need not agree there." : "With the exact end displacements prescribed, the difference is the discretization error alone."}
      ${avg ? "The stresses are averaged at the nodes. Turn the averaging off in the Solution tab to see each element's own stresses."
            : html`The line x₁ = L/2 is an edge between two elements, and the stresses jump across it: red is the element on the left, orange the element on the right.
               With Q4 elements, σ₁₂ on the two sides differs widely, and one side may even have the wrong sign.
               That is the spurious shear strain of the bending modes, the cause of shear locking. With Q9 elements the two sides nearly agree.`}
      <div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.8rem">${p1}${p2}${p3}</div></div>`;
  }
  if (geom === "plate" || geom === "quarter") {
    const a = PLATE.a, Wh = PLATE.W / 2;
    const st = bcState.right && bcState.right.x && bcState.right.x[0] === "traction" ? bcState.right.x[1] : 0;
    const ys = d3.range(0, 61).map(k => a + k * (Wh - a) / 60);
    const kir = y => { const q = (a / y) ** 2; return st * (1 + 0.5 * q + 1.5 * q * q); };
    const data = ys.map(y => ({y, fe: at(0, y, "s11"), ex: kir(y)}));
    const p = Plot.plot({width: Math.min(width, 520), height: 260, x: {label: "x₂, along the line x₁ = 0 above the hole (mm)"}, y: {label: "σ₁₁ (MPa)"}, marks: [
      Plot.line(data, {x: "y", y: "ex", stroke: "#1a1a1a", strokeDasharray: "5,4"}), Plot.line(data, {x: "y", y: "fe", stroke: "#c0392b", strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.ruleY([st], {stroke: "#999"})]});
    return html`<div style="font-size:0.93rem; line-height:1.55">σ₁₁ above the hole: the finite element solution (red) and Kirsch's solution for a hole in an <i>infinite</i> plate under the same remote stress (dashed).
      Both peak at the hole and fall off within a few radii.
      The finite plate's peak is higher, because the material beside the hole carries the whole load across a narrower section, and its stress at the free edge is lower.
      ${st ? html`Heywood's estimate of the peak for this width: ${fmt(heywood(2 * a, PLATE.W, st).peak, 1)} MPa.` : "Apply a traction along x₁ on the right end to compare with Kirsch's solution."}
      ${p}</div>`;
  }
  // the W-shape: von Mises along the underside of the top flange, from the web to the tip
  const {d, bf, tf, tw} = WSHAPE, yv = d - tf;
  const xs = d3.range(0, 121).map(k => tw / 2 + 0.01 + k * (bf / 2 - tw / 2 - 0.02) / 120);
  const data = xs.map(x => ({x, vm: at(x, yv, "vm")}));
  const p = Plot.plot({width: Math.min(width, 520), height: 260, x: {label: "x₁ along the underside of the top flange (mm)"}, y: {label: "von Mises stress (MPa)", zero: true}, marks: [
    Plot.line(data, {x: "x", y: "vm", stroke: "#c0392b", strokeWidth: 2}), Plot.ruleX([tw / 2], {stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "4,3"})]});
  return html`<div style="font-size:0.93rem; line-height:1.55">The von Mises stress along the underside of the top flange, from the face of the web (dashed line) to the flange tip${avg ? ", averaged at the nodes" : ", element by element"}.
    Refine the mesh and watch the value at the corner: it keeps rising, because the exact stress there is infinite, while the stress a little way along the flange settles down.
    ${p}</div>`;
}
```

:::
